added_claims.quote: a lot of the covid policies and things like that were actually causing a breakdown in Supply chains and then that caused prices to go up

added_claims.claim: Because the dollar is a debt-backed system with a huge eurodollar layer rather than a gold-backed one, the Fed can only normalize after debt/GDP has fallen; tightening first breaks markets, which is why letting inflation run hot is needed more now than after WWII.
